segments.name: Shipping
segments.description: Owns and operates LPG carriers, mainly VLGCs, on spot voyages and time charters for customers.
segments.evidence: The operation of the Group's fleet of VLGCs has historically been the Group's core activity.

segments.name: Product Services
segments.description: Buys LPG and delivers it directly to customers, so end customers secure supply at the point of consumption.
segments.evidence: Product Services provides customers with integrated LPG delivery services, by purchasing LPG and delivering it directly to customers.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for spot voyages, time charter voyages and sale of LPG cargo.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenues from external customers are derived mainly from spot voyages, time charter voyages and sale of LPG cargo.
